name: What factors influence the cost of a seismic upgrade?
description: Cost factors for seismic upgrades include building size, age, structural type, existing vulnerabilities, and retrofit complexity.

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of a seismic upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a seismic upgrade is influenced by the building's size, age, structural type, existing vulnerabilities, and the complexity of the required retrofit. For instance, a soft-story retrofit may differ significantly from a foundation bolting project. An initial structural assessment by a qualified professional can help determine the scope and estimated cost for your specific property.
